title: chat-server: create_message stores and enqueues as one unit
description: Supersedes JMAP-i61u (chinwag-dxgx.28). New ChatBackend method create_message(caller, account_id, create_id, build) -> Result<(Id, Message), BackendSetError<_>> 'store an owner-composed Message and report its OutboundEvent::NewMessage as one unit: on Err nothing is stored and nothing is enqueued'. Default = today's behaviour (create_object then on_outbound_event), correct per the spec-method-defaults rule. message.rs ~L1691-1709 calls backend.create_message instead of create_object + on_outbound_event. MemoryBackend: one lock for mint, build, check_metadata_create, insert, state/changes, outbound_events push (factor a locked insert helper out of create_object). Document: an overriding backend may fail the create when the enqueue fails -> notCreated serverFail. Tests: new tests/message_create_atomic.rs with InjectableBackend: failing create_message -> notCreated serverFail, no Message, no state advance, no event; default impl keeps today's event order. Oracle: chat-00 §Message/set (store then enqueue for outbound delivery), backend.rs create_object atomicity contract. BREAKING (handler call path; trait method has a default).
